title: Enkii
author: Mélodie Marcet
description:
NOTE: With the end of IFComp and the closure of the comp website's "Play Online" feature, this game's central mechanic has stopped working!

A new functional version will be uploaded ASAP to the IF Archive (if found to be compatible) or else self-hosted by the author.

The downloadable file may still work for playing locally, depending on your browser and setup.

—

I keep asking myself why I even came here, and then reminding myself, and then questioning myself again.

Is there really any chance I could make a difference?
